mapper.sql:
wi.deleted_at IS NULL
AND 1 = 0
AND wi.project_id IN
#{pid}
AND wi.project_id = #{projectId}
AND wi.flagged = true
AND wi.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE', 'HOLD')
AND wi.assignee_id IS NULL AND wi.common_status <> 'DONE'
AND 1 = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT wi.* FROM work_items wi WHERE
ORDER BY wi.priority DESC, wi.due_date ASC NULLS LAST, wi.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM work_items wi WHERE
SELECT common_status AS key, count(*) AS count FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY common_status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT issue_type AS key, count(*) AS count FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY issue_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT CAST(assignee_id AS varchar) AS key, count(*) AS count FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY assignee_id ORDER BY count DESC
